oracleRisk.summary: HKGXToken uses token quantities and has no external price-feed or borrower liquidation path. Ordinary terms let the administrator set and change the token-to-bar Exchange Rate. The 15 October 2026 special USDT exit uses the deadline-date Hong Kong weighted-average traded price, with issuer discretion over sources and a fair-price fallback if data are insufficient. Pricing sources and detailed methodology remain confidential. Both exits therefore depend on privileged off-chain pricing rather than an immutable conversion ratio.
